name: Garf***d
source:
Garf***d is the Unfortunate Nekomata. As one of the "unfortunate monsters", her body features are completely that of a nekomata, with no signs of human traits. She, like Gnome, has no form of dialogue whatsoever other than extended ellipses.

[Edited from [url=https://mgq.miraheze.org/wiki/Garfunkel]Mon-musu Quest Wiki[/url]]
